name: Karaoke highlight
summary: A full sentence on screen with an accent colour sweeping through it, for sing-along lyrics and read-along captions.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks if the sentence runs long

params.name: dur
params.note: frames for the sweep to finish

params.name: seed
params.note: unique id prefix; change if two copies share a screen

author: krakujs
